svg.title: Inside the Setsuna Agent Loop
svg.desc: A turn is admitted per thread, writes initial events, rebuilds context for each sampling step, streams a model response, executes approved tools when requested, feeds tool results back into the next step, and finalizes through a persisted event spine. Queue, steer, hooks, collaboration, cancellation, usage, titles, and memory are coordinated around the loop.
svg.text: A recoverable, event-driven cycle of context building, model sampling, tool execution, and finalization.

g.text: shutdown and migration can close admission
stable task kind and turn identity
stopped Hooks can complete without sampling

read-only batches may run in parallel

file, shell, browser, MCP, Skill, memory...

svg.text: NO TOOL CALLS · NO PENDING CONTINUATION

g.text: Inputs remain durable while one task owns the thread.
Some paths resample now; goals can schedule a later run.
